name: Upbit 30-minute +10% spike chase with 15% peak drawdown exit
author: InvestFactCheck synthesis of community spike-chasing concept
instruments: Upbit KRW markets; eligible coins subject to 24h trading value >= KRW 100m
entry_long: Buy when close is >=10% above lowest price over prior 30 minutes
exit: Exit when price falls 15% from post-entry peak; source also tested time exit variant
claimed_performance: Source reports this tested rule lost on its sample; self-published experiment.
implementation_notes: A community hypothesis synthesized/tested by source; fills/slippage are source-specific, signal close vs entry fill must be reconciled.
